payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over bit positions with two states tracking condition (AND >= XOR) using precomputed sums of binomial coefficients for choices of bits across n elements.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates through bits, maintaining dp[bit][0/1] for the result. Transitions rely on even/odd binomial sums to account for all combinations of setting bits in the n numbers. This is combinatorial DP.
